title: Trillion-Parameter AI Goes Open Source, No Supercomputer Needed
description:
A nearly trillion parameter model just went fully open source 🔥 It reads text, images and audio at once, with a context window up to a million tokens. Its MoE inside so only 40B out of 1000B fire per request, no supercomputer needed 😅 Weights are already on Hugging Face, download and fine tune it on you'r own data ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
